questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design a per-tenant provenance flow, integrate image signing and SBOMs, and apply admission controls with policy-as-code. It also checks practical knowledge of Gatekeeper/OPA integration, namespace-scoped policies, and minimal test workflows.

## Key Concepts

- Cosign signing with tenant-specific keys
- SPDX SBOM attachment and verification
- Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate and Constraint
- Per-tenant policy in a ConfigMap
- Minimal manifests and kubectl validation in a single namespace

## Code Example

```yaml
# ConstraintTemplate (yaml)
apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: ConstraintTemplate
metadata:
  name: k8simageprovenance
spec:
  crd:
    spec:
      names:
        kind: K8sImageProvenance
  targets:
  - target: admission.k8s.gatekeeper.sh
    rego: |
      package k8simageprovenance
      violation[{"msg": msg}] {
        input.review.kind.kind == "Deployment"
        some c in input.review.object.spec.template.spec.containers
        not startswith(c.image, "ghcr.io/")
        msg := "image provenance missing or not tenant-approved"
      }
```

```yaml
# Constraint (yaml)
apiVersion: constraints.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: K8sImageProvenance
metadata:
  name: per-tenant-provenance
spec:
  enforcementAction: deny
  parameters:
    allowedTenant: "tenant-a"
```

```yaml
# Compliant Deployment (yaml)
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gateway
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: ghcr.io/tenant-a/gateway:v1.0.0
```

```yaml
# Noncompliant Deployment (yaml)
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-gateway-bad
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gateway
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: unsigned/gateway:latest
```

```bash
# Kubectl steps (one namespace first)
kubectl create ns tenant-a
# 1) Register constraint template and constraint
kubectl apply -f k8simageprovenance_template.yaml
kubectl apply -f k8simageprovenance_constraint.yaml
# 2) Sign and SBOM-attach a valid image (tenant-a key)
cosign sign --key cosign-tenant-a.key ghcr.io/tenant-a/gateway:v1.0.0
# 3) Deploy compliant manifest
kubectl apply -f compliant-deploy.yaml -n tenant-a
# 4) Deploy noncompliant manifest (unsigned)
kubectl apply -f noncompliant-deploy.yaml -n tenant-a
# 5) Check Gatekeeper denials and logs
kubectl get events -n tenant-a
kubectl describe deployment tenant-a-gateway-bad -n tenant-a
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you rotate tenant keys without downtime?
- How would you extend to multi-tenant namespaces concurrently?

- Sidecar pattern, ConfigMaps, per-tenant routing, traffic shadowing, sandbox namespace.

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: shadow-config
  namespace: tenant-a
data:

    { tenantID: tenant-a, percent: 20, sandboxNamespace: shadow-tenant-a }
```

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: cnf/gateway:latest
      - name: shadow-sidecar
        image: cnf/shadow-sidecar:latest

        - name: shadow-config
          mountPath: /etc/cnf/shadow.json

      volumes:

          name: shadow-config
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates understanding of tenant isolation, mTLS, and certificate rotation using cert-manager in a CNF (Cloud-Native Function) gateway context. It also assesses practical knowledge of in-cluster secret management and sidecar integration patterns.

## Key Concepts
- Kubernetes Secrets and per-tenant namespace isolation
- Mutual TLS termination in a gateway sidecar
- cert-manager Issuers and automatic certificate rotation
- Tenant identity extraction from X.509 certificates

## Code Example
```yaml
# Per-tenant CA Issuer
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Issuer
metadata:
  name: tenant-ca-issuer
  namespace: tenant-namespace
spec:
  ca:
    secretName: tenant-ca-cert
---
# Certificate with auto-rotation
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: tenant-server-tls
  namespace: tenant-namespace
spec:
  secretName: tenant-<id>-tls
  issuerRef:
    name: tenant-ca-issuer
    kind: Issuer
  duration: 168h
  renewBefore: 72h
  dnsNames:
    - gateway.tenant-namespace.svc.cluster.local
  subject:
    organizations:
      - tenant-<id>
---
# Gateway Deployment with mTLS sidecar
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway
  namespace: tenant-namespace
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8443
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tls-certs
          mountPath: /etc/tls
          readOnly: true
      - name: mtls-sidecar
        image: mtls-proxy:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 9443
        env:
        - name: TENANT_CA_PATH
          value: /etc/certs/ca.crt
        - name: VALIDATE_CLIENT_CERTS
          value: "true"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tls-certs
          mountPath: /etc/tls
          readOnly: true
        - name: tenant-ca
          mountPath: /etc/certs
          readOnly: true
      volumes:
      - name: tls-certs
        secret:
          secretName: tenant-<id>-tls
      - name: tenant-ca
        secret:
          secretName: tenant-ca-cert
```

## Validation One-Namespace Manifest
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: tenant-001
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: tenant-ca-cert
  namespace: tenant-001
type: kubernetes.io/tls
data:
  tls.crt: <base64-encoded-ca-cert>
  tls.key: <base64-encoded-ca-key>
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Issuer
metadata:
  name: tenant-ca-issuer
  namespace: tenant-001
spec:
  ca:
    secretName: tenant-ca-cert
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: tenant-001-tls
  namespace: tenant-001
spec:
  secretName: tenant-001-tls
  issuerRef:
    name: tenant-ca-issuer
    kind: Issuer
  duration: 168h
  renewBefore: 72h
  dnsNames:
    - gateway.tenant-001.svc.cluster.local
  subject:
    organizations:
      - tenant-001
```

## Key Implementation Details
1. **Certificate Rotation**: cert-manager automatically renews certificates before expiration using the `renewBefore` field
2. **Tenant Isolation**: Each tenant has isolated namespaces, CAs, and TLS secrets
3. **mTLS Validation**: The sidecar validates client certificates against the tenant-specific CA
4. **Tenant ID Extraction**: The tenant ID is extracted from the certificate subject (organization field) to enforce access policies

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Real-world upgrades in multi-tenant CNF platforms require safe, isolated releases. This tests your ability to design rollout strategies, implement metrics-based promotion decisions, and enforce cross-tenant risk controls.

## Key Concepts
- Argo Rollouts canary strategy scoped per tenant
- Tenant isolation via labels and service mesh subsets
- Per-tenant AnalysisRun with Prometheus-based SLAs
- Rollback and auto-promotion guardrails
- Minimal CRD sketches and namespace-scoped validation

## Code Example
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: gateway-rollout-tenant-a
  labels:
    tenant: a
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    canary:
      steps:
        - setWeight: 10
        - analysis:
            templates:
              - templateName: tenant-a-analysis
        - setWeight: 30
        - analysis:
            templates:
              - templateName: tenant-a-analysis
        - setWeight: 100
      trafficRouting:
        nginx:
          stableIngress: gateway-ingress
          additionalIngressAnnotations:
            canary-by-header: X-Tenant-ID
      analysis:
        successfulRunHistoryLimit: 3
        unsuccessfulRunHistoryLimit: 3
```

## Per-Tenant AnalysisRun CRD Sketch
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: AnalysisTemplate
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-analysis
spec:
  args:
    - name: tenant-id
  metrics:
    - name: latency-sli
      interval: 1m
      successCondition: result[0] <= 100
      failureLimit: 3
      provider:
        prometheus:
          address: http://prometheus:9090
          query: |-
            histogram_quantile(0.99,
              sum(rate(gateway_request_duration_seconds_bucket{tenant="{{args.tenant-id}}"}[5m]))
              by (le))
    - name: error-rate-sli
      interval: 1m
      successCondition: result[0] <= 0.01
      failureLimit: 3
      provider:
        prometheus:
          address: http://prometheus:9090
          query: |-
            sum(rate(gateway_requests_total{tenant="{{args.tenant-id}},status=~"5.."}[5m]))
            /
            sum(rate(gateway_requests_total{tenant="{{args.tenant-id}}"}[5m]))
```

## One-Namespace Test Manifest
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-canary-test
  labels:
    tenant: a
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: gateway-stable
  namespace: tenant-a-canary-test
spec:
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
  selector:
    app: gateway
    role: stable
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: gateway-canary
  namespace: tenant-a-canary-test
spec:
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
  selector:
    app: gateway
    role: canary
---
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: gateway-rollout
  namespace: tenant-a-canary-test
  labels:
    tenant: a
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gateway
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gateway
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: gateway
          image: gateway:v2
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
  strategy:
    canary:
      canaryService: gateway-canary
      stableService: gateway-stable
      trafficRouting:
        service:
          canaryWeight: 10
      steps:
        - setWeight: 10
        - pause: {duration: 5m}
        - setWeight: 30
        - pause: {duration: 5m}
        - setWeight: 100
```

## Traffic Isolation Design
- **Service Mesh Subsets**: Each tenant gets dedicated subsets (stable/canary) in the mesh, ensuring zero cross-tenant traffic bleed
- **Tenant Labels**: All resources (Rollouts, Services, AnalysisRuns) are labeled with tenant ID for RBAC and policy enforcement
- **Network Policies**: Kubernetes NetworkPolicies restrict pod-to-pod communication to same-tenant pods only
- **Ingress Routing**: Use header-based routing (X-Tenant-ID) at the ingress to route to tenant-specific services

## Per-Tenant Metrics Collection
- Deploy tenant-scoped Prometheus instances or use Prometheus tenants
- Configure recording rules per tenant for SLI computation
- Metrics queries always include tenant filter to ensure isolation
- Store metrics with tenant label for multi-tenant querying and alerting

## Policy Enforcement
- **OPA/Gatekeeper**: Enforce that Rollouts must have tenant label and cannot modify other tenants' resources
- **Kubernetes RBAC**: Bind roles to tenant groups, limiting access to tenant-specific namespaces
- **Argo Rollouts RBAC**: Restrict Rollout/AnalysisTemplate access to tenant admins only

questions.explanation:
## Why This Question Matters
This question assesses your understanding of certificate rotation, CSR workflows, SPIFFE identities, and tenant isolation in Kubernetes-based CNF (Cloud-Native Function) gateway platforms. It validates your ability to design lifecycle management solutions that operate without downtime and your competence in developing testable configurations before production rollout.

## Key Concepts
- Per-tenant CSR issuance within Kubernetes
- Rotating CA with short-lived certificates for enhanced security
- SPIFFE identities and TLS handshakes in multi-tenant CNF gateways
- Tenant isolation using separate namespaces

## Solution Architecture

### 1. Minimal CA Manifest

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: tenant-ca
  namespace: cnf-gateway
type: kubernetes.io/tls
data:
  ca.crt: <base64-encoded-CA-certificate>
  ca.key: <base64-encoded-CA-private-key>
```

### 2. CSR Flow and Approval Policy

```yaml
apiVersion: certificates.k8s.io/v1
kind: CertificateSigningRequest
metadata:
  name: gateway-csr
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  groups:
  - system:authenticated
  request: <base64-encoded-CSR>
  signerName: kubernetes.io/kube-apiserver-client
  usages:
  - digital signature
  - key encipherment
  - client auth
---
apiVersion: certificates.k8s.io/v1
kind: CertificateSigningRequest
metadata:
  name: gateway-csr
spec:
  approval:
  - user: system:controller:certificates-approver
    approval: true
  conditions:
  - type: Approved
    reason: TenantIdentityValidated
    message: CSR identity matches tenant namespace
```

### 3. Per-Tenant CA Rotation Policy (30-Day Renewal)

```yaml
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Issuer
metadata:
  name: tenant-ca-issuer
  namespace: cnf-gateway
spec:
  ca:
    secretName: tenant-ca
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: gateway-cert
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  secretName: gateway-tls
  issuerRef:
    name: tenant-ca-issuer
    kind: Issuer
  commonName: gateway.tenant-a.cnf
  dnsNames:
  - gateway.tenant-a.cnf
  spiffeURIs:
  - spiffe://cnf/tenant-a/gateway
  duration: 720h # 30 days
  renewBefore: 168h # 7 days before expiry
  usages:
  - digital signature
  - key encipherment
  - client auth
  - server auth
```

### 4. Test Manifest with Sidecar Validation

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: tenant-a
  labels:
    tenant-id: tenant-a
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  ports:
  - port: 8443
    targetPort: 8443
  selector:
    app: gateway
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gateway
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gateway
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: cnf-gateway:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8443
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tls-certs
          mountPath: /etc/tls
          readOnly: true
        env:
        - name: SPIFFE_ID
          value: spiffe://cnf/tenant-a/gateway
      volumes:
      - name: tls-certs
        secret:
          secretName: gateway-tls
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: test-validator
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  restartPolicy: Never
  containers:
  - name: validator
    image: curl:latest
    command: ["sh", "-c"]
    args:
    - |
      # Validate TLS handshake
      openssl s_client -connect gateway:8443 \
        -CAfile /etc/tls/ca.crt \
        -cert /etc/tls/tls.crt \
        -key /etc/tls/tls.key \
        -verify_return_error
    volumeMounts:
    - name: tls-certs
      mountPath: /etc/tls
      readOnly: true
  volumes:
  - name: tls-certs
    secret:
      secretName: gateway-tls
```

### 5. SPIFFE Identity Validation

Each tenant receives a SPIFFE identity in the format `spiffe://cnf/{tenant}/gateway`. The CSR approval policy validates that the requested identity matches the tenant's namespace before issuance, ensuring strict tenant isolation.

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to implement tenant-scoped feature gating, combining CRDs, policy-as-code, and canary-style risk mitigation in CNF gateways.

## Key Concepts
- FeatureGate CRD and TenantFeatureGate per-tenant
- OPA Gatekeeper: ConstraintTemplate and Constraint
- Path-based canary gating and per-tenant isolation
- Minimal YAML for CRD, policy, namespace, and a basic test

## Code Example
```yaml
# FeatureGate CRD (simplified)
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: featuregates.example.org
spec:
  group: example.org
  versions:
    - name: v1
      served: true
      storage: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
  scope: Namespaced
  names:
    plural: featuregates
    singular: featuregate
    kind: FeatureGate
```

```yaml
# ConstraintTemplate (OPA)
apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1
kind: ConstraintTemplate
metadata:
  name: k8sfeaturegate
spec:
  crd:
    spec:
      names:
        kind: K8sFeatureGate
  targets:
    - target: admission.k8s.gatekeeper.sh
      rego: |
        package k8sfeaturegate
        violation["deny"] {
          input.target.path == "/v1/beta"
          not input.review.object.metadata.annotations["tenant/feature-v1-beta"] == "enabled"
        }
```

```yaml
# Constraint (per-tenant)
apiVersion: constraints.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: K8sFeatureGate
metadata:
  name: tenant-v1beta-enabled
spec:
  match:
    kinds:
      - apiGroups: ["gateway.example.org"]
        kinds: ["GatewayRoute"]
  parameters:
    # feature flag key used in tenant annotation
    flagKey: "tenant/feature-v1-beta"
```

```yaml
# Namespace manifest enabling the flag
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: tenant-a
  annotations:
    tenant/feature-v1-beta: enabled
```

